products.name: Full-Day Halibut & Species in Season Charter
products.priceCaveat: Advertised person rate; separate whole-boat options and fuel surcharges are listed. This is not a checkout quote.

products.name: Kenai Fjords and Resurrection Bay Half Day Tour
products.priceCaveat: Advertised per-person rate; the private evening charter is a separate sale option. Confirm final charges with the operator.
products.durationEvidence: The half-day tour section states a trip length of 3.5 hours, with morning and afternoon departures. The private evening charter is a separate option.

products.name: Resurrection Bay Half Day Kayak Tour
products.priceCaveat: Advertised per-person rate, not a checkout total. Adult and Family Tour options have different group rules.
products.durationEvidence: Calculated from the published 8 AM–noon, 11:30 AM–3:30 PM, and 6–10 PM trip windows. The separate 2–2.5-hour figure refers to paddling time, not the whole tour.
products.description: Paddle Resurrection Bay’s western shoreline from Lowell Point with a guide, stopping ashore for snacks, hot drinks, and exploration.

products.name: Glacier Dog Sledding
products.priceText: $599 per adult, $610.50 with tax and land use fees
products.priceCaveat: Adult pricing; child and comfort-seat prices differ. Online booking fees are additional to the displayed tax/land-use amount.
products.durationEvidence: The operator describes the excursion as approximately 90 minutes. Arrive 15 minutes early; it recommends allowing about two hours overall.
products.description: Fly to Godwin Glacier by helicopter, ride a dog sled with a musher, and meet the huskies at the glacier camp.

products.name: Resurrection Bay Tour: Half-Day Kayaking, Two Trips Daily

products.description: Take a guided shoreline paddle in Resurrection Bay after a narrated drive through Seward and an introduction to kayaking.

products.name: Tonsina Point Kayak
products.priceCaveat: Advertised adult price. The page lists a separate $6 park fee per person added during booking.

products.description: Paddle from Lowell Point toward Tonsina Point in a tandem kayak, exploring Resurrection Bay’s coastline with a guide.
